decoding.stopping_policy: Use the model repository's pinned GenerationConfig eos_token_id exactly. Do not replace a list-valued native EOS configuration with tokenizer.eos_token_id.
decoding.pad_token_policy: Use native GenerationConfig pad_token_id when defined; otherwise tokenizer pad_token_id; otherwise fall back to the first native EOS ID. Padding does not affect semantic generation because evaluation uses batch size 1.

pilot_amendment.reason: The frozen pilot revealed that Phi-3.5 defines multiple native EOS IDs but the initial runner forced only tokenizer.eos_token_id, causing repeated answer blocks.
pilot_amendment.scope: Model-independent generation-harness correction made before full benchmark generation.

pilot_amendment_2.reason: The native-EOS pilot showed one Phi-3.5 response reaching the 450-token ceiling and being truncated before the JSON object completed.
pilot_amendment_2.scope: Applied identically to all models before full benchmark generation.
